items.label: Description
items.value: A modern rooftop venue in Lehi with Wasatch Mountain views, two indoor rooms (the Overlook and the Skylight Room) and an outdoor courtyard; tables, floor-length linens, centerpieces, a ceremony arch, AV and a venue host are included.

items.label: Address
items.value: 139 N Hunters Grove Ln, Suite 400, Lehi, UT 84043

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Both settings include setup/takedown, cleaning, tables, chairs, linens, easels, television, audio system, centerpieces, ceremony arch, venue host, bride room, groom room, full prep kitchen and parking
All-day rental 10am-11pm — $500
Additional hour — $200
Golf lounge (TrackMan simulator) — $200
Photo booth — $200/hour, 2-hour minimum
Alcohol-use fee — $400
Security deposit — $750
Bridal or baby shower, Setting 2, 9am-12pm, tables/chairs and televisions — $750 (deposit $250)

items.label: Deposit
items.value:
Security deposit — $750 ($250 for showers)
Signed contract and deposit reserve the date
Balance due 30 days before the event
Deposit refunded 10-15 business days after the event if no damage, excess cleaning or late departure
All cancellations forfeit the deposit; cancelling within 30 days forfeits the full rental fee

items.label: Indoors
items.value: The Overlook (3,200 sq ft), The Skylight Room

items.label: Outdoors
items.value: The Courtyard is an outdoor patio

items.label: Standing
items.value:
Setting 1: up to 700 flowing reception
Setting 2: up to 300 flowing reception

items.label: The Overlook
items.value: Sqft: 3200 · Setting: indoor · Note: largest room; folding glass doors to courtyard

items.label: The Courtyard
items.value: Sqft: 1300 · Setting: outdoor · Note: included in all rentals; used for ceremonies

items.label: Setting 1
items.value: Rooms: Overlook; Skylight Room; Courtyard · Seated: 280 · Flowing: 700 · Presentation: 300 · Mon-thu: $3,500 · Fri-sat: $4,500

items.label: Setting 2
items.value: Rooms: Skylight Room; Courtyard · Seated: 80 · Flowing: 300 · Mon-thu: $2,500 · Fri-sat: $3,500

items.label: Event coordinator
items.value: Venue coordinator onsite during the rental

items.label: Included items
items.value:
Chairs
Tables
Linens

Setup and takedown

items.label: Staff & coordination
items.value: Venue host / coordinator on-site during the rental (venue logistics, not planning)

items.label: TV
items.value: Built-in AV: television and audio system

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Mountain views
Outdoor courtyard (1,300 sq ft)
Courtyard used for outdoor ceremonies
Golf lounge with TrackMan simulator — $200
Photo booth — $200/hour

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Own caterer allowed (licensed and insured)
Venue gives recommendations

items.label: Alcohol
items.value:
Alcohol allowed with a $400 alcohol-use fee
Must use an approved licensed bartending vendor
No shots or straight liquor; service ends 90 minutes before the event ends; 5-hour maximum

items.label: Limits
items.value: no shots or straight liquor; service ends 90 minutes before event end; max 5 hours of service

items.label: Sparklers allowed
items.value: Sparklers are permitted only in the parking lot.

items.label: Sparklers
items.value:
Yes, in the parking lot only
Cold sparklers permitted

items.label: Times
items.value:
Mon-Thu 1pm-11pm
Fri-Sat 1pm-11pm
All-day 10am-11pm
Bridal or baby shower 9am-12pm

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
Additional hours $200/hour
Outdoor music must stop by 10pm
No confetti, petals, rice or streamers
Candles only if the flame is fully enclosed in glass
No fog machines or CO2 cannons indoors
Smoke-, vape- and drug-free
No tacking, taping or nailing decor

items.label: Accessibility
items.value: Accessible parking spaces in the lot

items.label: Parking
items.value:
Ample on-site parking
About 160 stalls
Weekday business-hours events may have limited parking (shared with building tenants)

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Seated capacity differs by page: Pricing and Weddings pages say 280 (Setting 1), home page says 300, FAQ says 200.
FAQ lists wedding hours as 4pm-11pm (all-day 11am-11pm) and overtime at $150 per half hour; the Pricing page says 1pm-11pm, all-day 10am-11pm, $200 per additional hour.

rules.note: Approved bartender; $400 fee; no shots; 5-hour maximum
Also no petals, rice or streamers
